title: Pharmacy Supply after Declined Payments on a Tailwise Autoship Subscription
content:
Declined payments hold back days from the planned supply days of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shipment when its package count is re-set under Tailwise Autoship. The count is taken from the declined payment attempts recorded on that subscription; each declined attempt counts, the first decline and every failed automatic retry alike.

**Clause.** Two or more declined payment attempts on the subscription in the last six months hold back 14 days; exactly one declined attempt in that period holds back 10 days; none holds back no days.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Declined payment attempts on the subscription in the last six months | Days held back |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 14 |
| exactly 1 | 10 |
| none | none |

**Hypothetical record.** A first decline and one failed retry, both within the last six months: two attempts, 14 days held back. A single decline seven months ago and none since: no attempt in the period, no days held back.
